changelog:
The Vault 2.0 — changes since 1.8

Added
- TCG V2: a Foundation catalogue sized dynamically to your collection, monthly releases, personalized printings, five fixed rarities, SPR parallels, and permanent card provenance. Existing cards are preserved.
- Physical binders, acquisition history, card customization, and a unified booster and binder Shop.
- Daily traders with rotating preferences and stock, card requests, selling, multi-card barter, refunds, and per-copy paid grading.
- Optional first-person Collection Room with saved layouts, furniture, parcels, binders, card displays, and visitors.
- Installable local themes with custom artwork, colors, textures, and fonts.
- Video Info displays resolution, duration, frame rate, format, codec, and bit rate.
- Expanded Videos and Funscripts workflows and independent script playlists.
- File-level curation alongside gallery curation: random individual photos and videos from across your collection, with beloved creators mixed in.
- Expanded Loading Bay imports and duplicate review, session analytics, Hall of Fame champion reigns and award cards, card mask editing, and automatic ComfyUI provenance tagging.
- Recoverable catalogue restoration and advanced owned-card cleanup controls.
- Optional release survey invitation after 15 minutes of use, with a remotely editable link and remembered dismissal.

Changed
- Card Collection is rebuilt around release sets and physical copies, with type-specific card faces, frozen artwork, and layered rarity effects.
- Windows uses bundled VLC in the existing Vault interface, including hover previews, without playback copies; browser and mobile playback remain available.
- Large-library browsing and playlist selection search the full collection, with paged loading and no 25,000-entry queue cutoff.
- Metadata edits refresh related screens automatically.
- Improved funscript output, remembered video preferences, theme coverage, and Simplified Chinese support.

Fixed
- More reliable file operations, Loading Bay, rankings, session timestamps, quests, dialogs, and translations.
- Purchases, trading, packs, parcels, and binders recover interrupted operations while preserving ownership and preventing duplicate charges.
- Bounded Dashboard statistics prevent runaway memory use; in-app updates verify downloads and detect completion.

Removed
- Published V2 cards retire the old evolution, Prestige, and crafting paths in favor of fixed print rarity, Shards, and physical customization. Obsolete rewards and unused trader placeholders are removed.
